note: One record, and the smallest legal creature the format allows: a name, an armour class, hit points, and a provenance. No team, no speed, no hit dice, no abilities, no attacks. It is a thing that stands in a field and can be hit, which is genuinely all some encounters need.

creatures.name: Quiet Fields Scarecrow
unmodelled: Everything optional is omitted on purpose: speed defaults to 30, attacks_per_action to 1, and it has no attack at all
It does not fight. It is here to be knocked down, set alight, or walked past
